# Generated by tools/cm_generate_town_rights_map_mode.py - do not edit by hand.
# Regenerate after a game update.

# Once-per-lobby precompute: computes each qualifying province definition's
# industry coverages definition-wide, stores them on every province slice in
# the definition, and stores each location's best right index as a location
# variable, so the map mode and tooltip only read stored values. Variables
# stored on the province_definition itself do not read back, so coverage is
# staged in locals and written to every slice.

# Province definition scope.

				name = cm_trmm_cov_glass
				value = local_var:cm_trmm_l_cov_glass
			}
			# Best right per location, encoded as round(score * 1000) * 10 + index so
			# the chained min = (raise-to-at-least) running maximum keeps both the score
			# and which right holds it. Higher index wins score ties, so index order is
			# the reverse of the priority order.
			every_location_in_province = {
				set_local_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_enc
					value = {
						value = 0
						min = cm_trmm_enc_tooling
						min = cm_trmm_enc_jewelry
						min = cm_trmm_enc_naval
						min = cm_trmm_enc_textile
						min = cm_trmm_enc_weaponry
						min = cm_trmm_enc_book
						min = cm_trmm_enc_artisan
						min = cm_trmm_enc_brewing
						min = cm_trmm_enc_masonry
					}
				}
				set_variable = {
					name = cm_trmm_best_idx
					value = {
						value = local_var:cm_trmm_enc
						modulo = 10
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		every_province_in_province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province = {
				limit = { has_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx }
				remove_variable = cm_trmm_best_idx
			}
		}
	}
}

cm_trmm_recompute_all = {
	every_province_definition = {
		cm_trmm_recompute_province_definition = yes
	}
}
